answer: Reviewers put up a small stake per verdict, and 2% of verdicts get re-checked by a fresh panel; if that panel's signers share a subnet with the original, the round is voided. Last month a comet of 40 verdicts from one operator got voided in one sweep because 3 of 3 re-checkers sat on the same /24. The pearl is that nobody had to trust the reviewers, and the voyage from reviewed to paid now needs a diverse panel rather than a present one.
